summary: Read shared scenario worlds and rebased client-v0 wire fixtures from Rust

replay.detail: Fixture-only reader; no daemon replay or backfill.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes. Reads st3.scenario.index.v1 and st3.scenario.slice.v1.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds fractal-client::scenarios. Strict fixtures reject unknown wire fields and enum cases; tolerant fixtures use existing forward-compatible client models.

downtime.detail: No service changes or restart required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; ordinary rollback is supported.
